Name: Seasonal Custom Farm Buildings (Official Content Patcher Version)
Author: Billy0815
Description:
After long years of waiting I can finally present you my official Content Patcher version of my Seasonal Custom Farm Buildings mod.
This mod is the direct successor of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1451?tab=description]my old mod for Seasonal Immersion.    
[/url][size=4][b][color=#e69138][url=https://ko-fi.com/billy0815]
[/url][/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][b][color=#fff2cc][u]
About this mod: [/u]

[/color][/b][/size]This mod changes most of the farm buildings.

The buildings are based on the vanilla buildings with changes according to my taste.
Since I don't like the original coloring of the game I focused on a realistic appearance with realistic colors.
I added many details to the building in accordance to the current season and in comparison to my old mod I added the new farm buildings which were added recently. Additionally I added some matching recolors of vanilla objects (floorings etc.) to achieve a consistent atmosphere on your farm.
Moreover this mod is configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and of course via config.json. Listed below I'll explain everything more precisely.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]
[/url][size=4][b][color=#fff2cc][u]What does this mod changes exactly? [/u]
[/color][/b][/size][b]
Every farm building except Junimo Huts and Obelisks (hopefully I'll add them in a future update):
[/b][size=3]
[list]
[*]Farmhouse including Greenhouse
[*]all three Barns
[*]all three Coops
[*]Shed and Big Shed
[*]Stable
[*]Silo
[*]Slime Hutch
[*]Well (configurable)
[*]Mill
[*]Fish ponds
[*]all variants of Cabins
[*]Shipping Bin
[/list][/size]

[b]Additional replacements:
[size=3]
[/size][/b][list]
[*][size=3]color matching flooring with seasonal variants for fall and winter[/size]
[*][size=3]color matching mailbox next to your farm house[/size]
[*][size=3]color matching pet area for your dog/cat[/size]
[*][size=3]color matching craftables with winter variant if placed outside[/size]
[*][size=3]color matching construction area from robin[/size]
[/list][size=4][b][color=#fff2cc][u]


[size=4][b][color=#fff2cc][u]Which mods are needed?

[/u][/color][/b][/size][/u][/color][/b][/size]Of course you'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and if you want an eas﻿y configuration you'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] since my mod is fully compatible with it.[size=4][b][color=#fff2cc][u][size=4][b][color=#fff2cc][u]
[/u][/color][/b][/size][/u][/color][/b][/size]
It's strongly recommended to use a map recolor since this mod is designed to represent a more subtle color scheme in comparison to the vanilla game.
I personally use a less yellow Stardew which looks best together in my opinion. You can use everything which suits your taste of course.
[size=4][b][color=#fff2cc][u]

How do I configure this mod?
[/u]  [/color][/b][/size]
It's strongly recommended to use this mod with its additions but if you doesn't like a certain object or mods are conflicting you can change them.
Regarding well: as default this mods comes with an ouhouse as a replacement for the well. You need to change it if you want a well instead.
If you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] you can hover over the options to get an explanation what every option change.
If you don't use the config menu:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]Outhouse: You can choose if you want an outhouse instead of the well: choose 'outhouse' then. If you want the well replaced as a well from this mod:
choose 'well'.[*]GoldenClock: If you want the golden clock replaced as an outhouse choose outhousec.
[*]Flooring: If true, you get the color matching flooring. 
[*]Fence: If true, you get the color matching custom fence which replaces the first fence.
[*]PetArea: If true, you get the color matching custom pet area for your dog/cat. Uncheck if you have a mod overwriting or messing with it. 
[*]Mailbox: If true, you get the color matching mailbox next to your farm house.
[*]ShippingBin: If true, you get the color matching shipping bin next to your farm house. The buildable shipping bin is replaced as well.
[*]RobinConstruction: If true, you get the color matching construction area when Robin is building something on your farm.[/spoiler]
[/list]
[size=4][b][color=#fff2cc][u]Future plans:

[/u][/color][/b][/size][list]
[*]a hedge as replacement for the stone fence (almost ready)
[*]custom matching Junimo Huts
[*]custom matching Obelisks
[*]more details on some buildings (e.g. plants in greenhouse)
[*]pethouse for your farm
[/list]

[size=2][b][size=4]If you have any questions, suggestions, need help with the installtion or [b]find errors [/b]feel free to write a comment.[/size][size=4]
I recommend to track this mod because I'll keep it updated.

[color=#f6b26b]
Feel free to add your own screenshots. I would love to see how it looks on different farms. ;)[/color][/size][/b][/size]
